title: A record that credits the owner must cite his page answer or his quoted words
why: Owner picked item 699 b at 11:08 CST Nov 13 after naming the incident: an audit in a repo that pulls in claude-settings found two decision records crediting him with picks a Claude session made (the closed-front-window rule and the Clear Board refill).
source: owner 11:08 CST Nov 13, item 699 b; coordinator yes 11:12 CST
note: The check refuses a record that says "owner" (or the owner's name) picked or ruled unless it cites answers/<id> on a page or an owner quote with its time. Red case: the two misattributed records. Starts after #2971 is handed in (699 b also merges #2971 as built). Guard fix that tracks who decided: express under ruling drain-first-hold part 4.
